title: Automatically build and release MSI files
author: darkpixel
body_snippet: Similar to how the original mRemoteNG project does it, I'd love to see MSI files automatically created when you cut a new release.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the suggestion! MSI installer generation is on our radar. Currently we distribute ZIP archives for portability. Keeping this open as a feature request.

Label: enhancement

## MSI Installer — Implemented in v1.82.0-beta.3 🎉

MSI installer generation is now live! Starting with this build, every nightly release includes an MSI alongside the ZIP.

### What's included

- **Windows Installer (MSI)** — installs to `C:\Program Files\mRemoteNG\` with proper Add/Remove Programs entry
- **Desktop & Start Menu shortcuts** (optional features during install)
- **Major upgrade support** — new versions automatically uninstall older ones
